text:
Letrilla


Tell me, shepherd lads,

what power can there be

in Lesbia's eyes,

that they hurt me so?

Since first I saw them

I do not know rest;

I lost my repose,

I cannot keep still.

Surely they must hold

some hidden fire,

for when they look at me,

I feel myself burn.

Yet this fire gives

no discomfort,

but only...

I cannot explain it.

Tell me, shepherd lads,

what power can there be

in Lesbia's eyes,

that they hurt me so?

translation.title: To Lucianela
translation.editorial_note: The translation regularizes the broken catalog lineation while keeping the letrilla's refrain and pastoral address.
